function.name: SAVE_MAP
function.abstract: It saves a graph in disk, in MAP format

description.p: This function saves any graph in disk in MAP format This graph can be in any FPG library, or has been created on memory with functions like o .
Any change made in the graph, as for example, changes in the control points, or changes in the content with functions like or , will be stored in the archive.

function.note: The archives created with SAVE_MAP can not be recovered from DIV Games Studio.
